title: Fae Audio Eval Corpus Entry
description: Annotation for a single audio clip in the eval corpus.

file.description: Filename of the WAV file (16kHz mono Float32).

class.description: Signal class for the recording environment.

noise_type.description: Specific noise source (e.g., running_water, tv_drama, fan).

transcript.description: Ground-truth transcript of the user speech (empty for silence/tts-only).

speech_onset_ms.description: Millisecond offset where user speech begins.

speech_offset_ms.description: Millisecond offset where user speech ends.

expected_keywords.description: Keywords the keyword classifier should detect.

is_interrupt.description: Whether this clip represents an interrupt attempt.

snr_estimate_db.description: Estimated SNR in dB (measured or computed post-hoc).
